result:
I've added the comment count and last-comment time to each row of the discussions list. I haven't run tests, lint, type-check or the app, as you asked.

- **Types:** `src/types/api.ts` has a new `DiscussionListItem`. It is `Discussion` plus `commentsCount: number` and `lastCommentAt: number | null`. `get-discussions.ts` now returns this type.
- **Mock API:** the `GET /discussions` handler in `src/testing/mocks/handlers/discussions.ts` looks up each discussion's comments. It returns their count and the newest `createdAt`, or `null` when there are none.
- **List:** `discussions-list.tsx` has two new columns. "Comments" shows the count. "Last Comment" shows the date through `formatDate`, or "No comments yet".

I added a separate list-item type instead of putting the new fields on `Discussion`. The single-discussion and create/update responses don't include them.

I did not touch `discussions.test.tsx`. If it asserts the exact columns or response shape, it may need updating.
